submission.overviewContent1: The Taiwan Society of Endoscopic Spine Surgery (TSESS) cordially invites clinicians, researchers, members, and young surgeons to submit their work for the TSESS 2026 Annual Meeting. Submissions may include clinical research, surgical techniques, surgical videos, education and training, navigation, imaging, instrumentation, and emerging technologies related to endoscopic spine surgery.
submission.overviewContent2: All Free Paper submissions will be reviewed by the TSESS 2026 Scientific Committee or designated reviewers. Accepted submissions will be assigned to the most appropriate presentation format (including Research, Surgical Video or Rapid Fire) based on academic quality, clinical relevance, innovation, educational value, maturity, topic balance, and program capacity.
submission.initialReviewDetail: Scientific Committee review and finalist selection
submission.notificationDetail: Acceptance, finalist status and presentation details announced
submission.finalCompetitionDetail: On-site presentations, judging and award ceremony
submission.researchContent: Clinical research, outcome analysis, case series, complication analysis, learning curve, registry, or multicenter study.
submission.surgicalVideoContent: Educational surgical video, technical pearls, bailout strategy, difficult case, or demonstration of emerging techniques.
submission.submissionTypeNote: Authors should indicate whether the submission is Research or Surgical Video. The final presentation format will be determined by the Scientific Committee (Research, Surgical Video or Rapid Fire).
submission.format1Selection: Selected from all Free Paper submissions for the most complete works with strong academic and educational value.
submission.format2Selection: Strong accepted submissions suitable for formal oral presentation but not selected as Best Competition finalists.
submission.format3Selection: Submissions with a clear message or educational value but with a narrower scope, earlier-stage data, or a concise presentation format.
submission.bestCompetitionContent1: The Best Endoscopic Presentation Competition is the main competition program of the meeting. Finalists will be selected from all Free Paper submissions to recognize outstanding work in endoscopic spine surgery with academic quality, clinical relevance, innovation, and educational value.
submission.bestCompetitionContent2: Surgical Video finalists should present in a slide-based format with edited video clips. Full-length video playback cannot replace the oral presentation.
submission.freePaperSessionContent: Free Paper Session will include strong accepted submissions that are complete and suitable for formal oral presentation but are not selected as finalists for the Best Endoscopic Presentation Competition.
submission.rapidFireContent: Rapid Fire Presentation is suitable for submissions with a focused topic and clear clinical or educational message, but with a smaller dataset, earlier-stage results, or a format better suited to concise presentation. Rapid Fire presentations will not be included in the ranking of the Best Endoscopic Presentation Competition. A separate Best Rapid Fire Presentation award may be offered.
submission.topic1: Cervical, thoracic, lumbar, or sacral endoscopic spine surgery
submission.topic2: Full-endoscopic, uniportal, or biportal endoscopic spine surgery
submission.topic3: Clinical outcomes, complications, learning curve, and revision surgery
submission.topic4: Surgical strategy, technical pearls, bailout strategy, and difficult cases
submission.topic5: Navigation, imaging, instrumentation, simulation, and emerging technology
submission.topic6: Education, training, registry, multicenter study, and international collaboration
submission.topic7: Surgical video with clear educational value
submission.requirement4: Content type: Research or Surgical Video
submission.requirement5: Abstract or video summary, up to 400 words
submission.requirement6: Contribution to endoscopic spine surgery, up to 100 words
submission.requirement8: IRB approval number or exemption statement, if applicable
submission.requirement9: Prior presentation or publication disclosure, if applicable
submission.reviewOutcome3: TSESS Education and Training Forum thematic block
submission.reviewOutcomeNote: TSESS reserves the right to make final decisions regarding acceptance, presentation format, program assignment, schedule arrangement, and award eligibility.
